= Introduction =

Python port of the StreamToMe Server. [http://projectswithlove.com/streamtome StreamToMe] is an application that transcodes your video/music library live to your iPad, iPhone and iPod.


= Build Environemnt =

Ubuntu 10.04 Server using Python 2.6.5
